wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/msg15.txt: feat(streams): php's gz* surface, and the compress-wrapper gaps it uncovered

`gzopen`, `gzread`, `gzgets`, `gzgetc`, `gzwrite`, `gzputs`, `gzclose`, `gzeof`, `gztell`,
`gzseek`, `gzrewind`, `gzpassthru`, `gzfile` and `readgzfile` were all absent: a program touching
a gzip stream failed with "Undefined function". They are not implemented a second time — php-src
opens `gzopen` as a stream on the zlib wrapper, so the family IS the plain stream API over
`compress.zlib://`. Writing them that way is what exposed two silent gaps in that wrapper, so the
two halves are kept apart below.

--- THE WRAPP
